sentences.en: I woke up with a stiff neck after sleeping in an awkward position last night.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚睡觉姿势不对，早上起来觉得脖子发僵了。

sentences.en: She had to take a break from typing due to her stiff neck from staring at the computer screen for too long.
sentences.zh: 因为她盯着电脑屏幕太久，导致脖子发僵，所以不得不暂停打字。

sentences.en: The doctor advised him to do some gentle stretching exercises to relieve his stiff neck.
sentences.zh: 医生建议他做一些轻柔的伸展运动来缓解脖子发僵的问题。
